chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Purify your children on the seventh day, for it is the most pure, the most fragrant, and the fastest for the growth of the flesh, for the earth becomes impure from the urine of the uncircumcised for forty mornings.'
ai.seo_question: When should a male child be circumcised according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the seventh day as the optimal time for male circumcision, linking physical purity with spiritual cleanliness. It highlights the practical rationale that the earth remains impure from an uncircumcised child's urine for forty days, thereby emphasizing the importance of timely ritual hygiene in Shia jurisprudence.
